title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
constraints: Return floor of the actual median (truncate toward zero for even-length combined arrays)
description:
Given two sorted arrays `nums1` and `nums2` of size `m` and `n` respectively, return the **median** of the two sorted arrays.

The overall run time complexity should be `O(log(m + n))`.

**Note:** For this problem, when the combined array has even length, return the **floor** of the average of the two middle elements (i.e., integer division).

```text
nums1 = [1, 3],  nums2 = [2]

Merged: [1, 2, 3]   -> median = 2

nums1 = [1, 2],  nums2 = [3, 4]

Merged: [1, 2, 3, 4]  -> median = floor((2+3)/2) = 2
```
